chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

Concerning a man who forgets the adhan and the iqamah until he enters into the salat (prayer), he said: “If he remembers before he recites, then let him send blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and let him give the iqamah; but if he has already recited, then let him complete his salat (prayer).”

key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْأَذَانَ: the call to prayer made before salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةَ: the second call immediately preceding the start of congregational or individual salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَقْرَأَ: to recite, meaning the recitation within the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets the adhan and iqamah until after starting salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who forgets the adhan and iqamah and only remembers after beginning the salat (prayer). If he remembers before recitation, he should invoke blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and perform the iqamah; if he has already recited, he should continue and complete the prayer.
